children.label: Advanced Lab Elective

children.label: BMB Electives
children.devNote: CASMB722 (MB 722, corrected from an earlier GMSMB722 guess) is a catalog data gap — neither CASMB722 nor GMSMB722 resolves to a document in the `courses` Firestore collection as of 2026-08-09 (confirmed via a live public read, not just a local guess), so this elective can't be auto-tracked if a student has taken it. Same pattern as the FYW/WRI gap in HUB_REQUIREMENTS.md: flagged rather than guessed further, pending a catalog scrape/import that actually includes this course.
children.note: Other courses may count by petition or department approval. GMS BI 751 (6 units) can't be combined with CH 373, BB 421, or BB 422 for credit. Neither is checked automatically.

children.label: Related: Mathematics/Computer Science
At least one Calculus or Statistics course
Second Related course (Calculus, Statistics, or Computer Science)

children.devNote: The bulletin requires 2 courses total with at least 1 from the calculus/statistics subset. Expressed as a COUNT(min 1, calc/stats-only pool) plus a REMAINDER that fills the 2nd slot from the full combined pool — composing the two guarantees the subset minimum without needing a node type that expresses 'min 1 of a subset' directly. Hidden prerequisite: CAS CH 525 (Physical Biochemistry, required core) lists MA 121 or MA 123 as an undergraduate prerequisite per the course page. The Related Math/CS requirement can otherwise be met with statistics or CS alone, so students can miss this.
children.note: CH 525, one of the required core courses, needs MA 121 or MA 123 first. Make sure your calculus course here is MA 121 or MA 123, not only statistics or computer science.

children.label: Related: Physics Sequence
children.devNote: PY 241 and PY 242 don't appear anywhere in the local catalog scrape (bu_courses_all.csv) or the `courses` Firestore collection (confirmed via a live public read, 2026-08-09) — unlike CH 111 in the General Chemistry Sequence above, they're also not referenced as a prerequisite anywhere else in the catalog, so this option couldn't be independently corroborated as a currently-offered BU sequence. Kept as-is since it was already in the prior bulletin transcription rather than guessed away, but worth a human check against the current bulletin.

children.label: BU residency requirement
children.devNote: Excluding Foundation Courses, at least 5 courses counting toward the BMB major must be taken in the BU BMB Program — not tracked, since the engine doesn't currently distinguish which claimed courses are transfer credit vs. taken at BU.
children.note: At least 5 courses counting toward the major (not counting Foundation Courses) must be taken in the BU BMB Program. This isn't checked automatically.
